description: You can compare three containers by their storage and insertion operations. An iterator identifies a position in a container.

steps.description: vector stores elements contiguously. The example appends one element and inserts another at an interior position.
deque is a double-ended queue. The example adds an element at each end.
list stores doubly linked nodes. Given an iterator, it can insert before that position.
splice moves an existing node within the list. The comment identifies this as a move without allocation.

title: Compare sequence containers
